shacl12Qualification: advisory only; promote explicitly after Recommendation status and full engine support for every emitted feature
jenaDurationProcessor: Jena's value-based validation-report model can throw NumberFormatException for seconds components beyond Int32; shared boundary probes use equivalent canonical day/time forms without narrowing COGS lexical validity
owlapiCardinality: OWLAPI's Java object model uses int cardinalities; the gate profile-checks the Turtle ontology and separately verifies arbitrary-size Turtle cardinality lexemes without claiming a lossless OWLAPI round trip
javaJaxpXsd: not a conformance gate: Xerces rejects standards-valid maxOccurs values beyond its machine occurrence range
dctapChecker: checked-in semantic profile validator (shape linkage, node/datatype compatibility, cardinality booleans, constraints, and valueShape resolution)
owlStructuralReasoner: OWLAPI 5.5.1 parser and OWL 2 DL profile gate
eclipseUml2: not invoked: current Eclipse UML2 is distributed as a p2 site rather than a stable Maven Central standalone; checked-in semantic XMI validation is authoritative for generated UML structure
officialXmiSchemas: audit-only: OMG schema downloads are not reproducibly versioned
